newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street seen steady at open, quiet until FOMC.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street seen steady at open, quiet until FOMC.

text.p: Wall Street is seen opening quietly on Tuesday, with most share prices treading water until Federal Reserve policy-makers announce whether they will boost U.S. short-term interest rates.

The Federal Open Market Committee, the Fed's policy arm starts meeting at 1300 GMT to discuss interest rates. Economists are divided as to whether it will take action against inflation by raising the federal funds rate.
Stocks idled on Monday ahead of the meeting, with the Dow industrials ending up 34.21 points at 7,228.88 in light trade.
Market-watchers expect more of the same until the FOMC delivers its verdict on rates, expected at around 1815 GMT.
